notes: Work-type scoring dictionary and the shared field catalogue. Weights: 3 = strong (unambiguous, type-specific), 2 = medium (fairly specific), 1 = weak (generic, cross-type). Every brief is scored against every type; highest total wins.

objective.label: Objective / Goal
objective.question: What is the objective of this page — why is it needed and what should it achieve?

detect.regex: objective|goal|purpose|aim|rationale|business case|so that|in order to|we need this

target_location.label: Target Page Location / Path
target_location.question: What's the target page URL or path for this change?

detect.regex: page path|structure group|located at|sits under|will live at|path:

component_content.label: Component Content
component_content.question: Which components are needed, and what content goes in each one?

page_title_seo.label: Page Title (SEO)
page_title_seo.question: What should the SEO Page Title be — 10–60 characters, and different from the H1?

detect.regex: page title|seo title|meta title|browser title|title tag

meta_description.label: Meta Description
meta_description.question: What should the meta description say — 120–160 characters, unique to this page?

detect.regex: meta ?description|meta desc|description tag

market.label: Target Region / Market
market.question: Which market or region is this for? Note the One-Ticket-Per-Market rule — one country per ticket.

named_approver.label: Named Approver
named_approver.question: Who is the named approver, and are they aware of the 3-day approval SLA?

detect.regex: approver|approved|approval from|sign ?-?off by|signed off|reviewed by|stakeholder is

reference_designs.label: Reference URLs / Designs

target_page_url.label: Target Page URL

new_content.label: New Content / Assets

environment.label: Environment

current_state.label: Current State
